key.name: directory
key.description: Folder that contains the images to show. Subfolders are included when 'recursive' is enabled.

key.name: interval-seconds
key.description: How long each wallpaper is shown before switching.

key.name: shuffle
key.description: When disabled, wallpapers are shown in alphabetical order.

key.name: recursive
key.description: Also scan subfolders of the wallpaper folder.

key.name: picture-options
key.description: How the wallpaper fills the screen (org.gnome.desktop.background picture-options).

key.name: restore-original
key.description: Restore the wallpaper that was active before the extension was enabled, when it is disabled.
